title: ZAPBench 64-frame, 256-neuron, 32-step forecasting
retrieval_date_semantics: accessed_on is this fresh retrieval, not publication date or proof of exhaustive indexing; null publication_date means not verified
search_queries: ZAPBench2026 benchmark best TiDE Nlinear NUNet

candidates.name: POCO
candidates.evidence: Population-conditioned forecasting; published ZAPBench short-context performance comparable to video U-Net, but long context underperforms U-Net/TSMixer in paper. No 64-frame-context, 256-selected-neuron result.
candidates.role: contender; not evaluated on our frozen slice

candidates.name: Time-Mix / TSMixer / TiDE
candidates.evidence: Original trace-model suite; long-context differences modest, linear worse. TiDE stimulus covariates are out-of-distribution on taxis and absent from our interface.
candidates.role: contender; not evaluated on our frozen slice

candidates.name: Volumetric U-Net
candidates.evidence: Original paper strongest overall short-context model; raw spatial volumes are richer input, not eligible as a same-trace comparator.
candidates.role: contender; not evaluated on our frozen slice

candidates.name: ERA tree-search generated forecaster
candidates.evidence: Published iterative AI software system includes ZAPBench; relevant strong learned procedure, not a one-shot general baseline or traditional handbuilt specialist.
candidates.role: contender; not evaluated on our frozen slice

candidates.name: SimpleTES generated programs
candidates.evidence: Current released whole-brain 4-context, 32-horizon task and result artifacts; repeated evaluation-driven search and official MAE differ from our MSE with 64-context and a neuron subset.
candidates.role: contender; not evaluated on our frozen slice

candidates.name: Analytical NLinear with ridge penalty 1
candidates.evidence: Current matched conventional domain baseline; changed optimization is explicitly documented.

current_best_claim_scope: Exact executed custom input/split/metric protocol, not best within our small inspected local set
current_reference: Shared temporal NLinear architecture analytically fitted with fixed ridge penalty 1
current_reference_limitations: Our 64-context, 256-neuron-subset MSE differs from published 4- or 256-context, full-brain MAE.
Taxis slice shares the same brain, neurons, training arrays and program; not independent evidence.
Published U-Net uses spatial raw video and cannot be transplanted into trace-only ranking.
Official NLinear architecture plus ridge penalty 1 is conventional, not best baseline.
Iterative AI search budgets differ substantially from one no-tool generation.
recommended_next_comparator: Highest-priority matched shortlist: POCO plus Time-Mix/TSMixer trained from scratch using exactly 64 past frames, the same 256 neuron columns and same training windows; no stimulus covariates. Use training-only validation and exact MSE on both frozen slices. Treat U-Net/full-brain pretrained or ERA/SimpleTES search as separate richer-input/resource tiers unless fully adapted and refrozen.
switching_assessment: NO GENERAL REPLACEMENT RECOMMENDATION. Current evidence supports a bounded code-synthesis/pilot comparison to the named local reference. Establish prospective same-input/split/metric contender runs, biological/source replication, calibration and runtime/reliability before switching production tools.
limitations: Our 64-context, 256-neuron-subset MSE differs from published 4- or 256-context, full-brain MAE.
Taxis slice shares the same brain, neurons, training arrays and program; not independent evidence.
Published U-Net uses spatial raw video and cannot be transplanted into trace-only ranking.
Official NLinear architecture plus ridge penalty 1 is conventional, not best baseline.
Iterative AI search budgets differ substantially from one no-tool generation.
negative_findings: No published exact 64-context, 256-neuron-subset MSE leaderboard winner verified.
2026 in-silico zebrafish mechanistic discovery papers use different simulated truth and are not real ZAPBench matches.
